reader.requirement: At 1985 the KEY IS data-name-1 of a Format 2 READ on an indexed file must name the prime or an alternate record key of file-name-1 (possibly qualified, SR3; an item at the key's identical character positions in another record description of the file is implicitly that key, IX.2.7.4 GR3); any other data item (non-key field, group, working-storage item, another file's key, a shorter item at the key's leftmost position, a reference-modified key) is refused. The witness covers only the reference-modified operand and was written for the 2023 rule.
reader.edition-search: grep for Edition, Year, CobolVersion, DialectBehavior in KeyedIoBinder.cs and RecordLayout.cs KeyIndexOfKeyItem: the only uses of ctx.Edition on the READ KEY path are the diagnostic sink (BoundRejected.Report(ctx.Edition, ...), severity routing, not a rule switch); the record-key-name arm (RecordKeyNameOf) is reachable only from a 2023 SOURCE-form key, which a 1985 program cannot declare. The rule is one edition-invariant identity check.

reader.notes: KeyedIoBinder.BindRead asks RecordLayout.KeyIndexOfKeyItem, an identity-or-identical-position match against the declared keys, and refuses everything else with COBOL0864. Accepting an item at the prime key's identical positions in a second record rests on §1985:IX.2.7.4 GR3 ('implicitly referenced as keys'); that is the one interpretive point. The diagnostic cites §2023:14.9.30.3 SR11 rather than the 1985 rule, which is wording only.

refuter.evidence: r3-redef.cob: in the key's own record, 05 IX-KR REDEFINES IX-KEY PIC X(4); READ IXF KEY IS IX-KR compiles at --std 85 (EXIT 0) and at --std 2023 (EXIT 0). IX-KR is not specified in a RECORD KEY or ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause, and GR3's implicit keys reach only OTHER record description entries. A level-05 REDEFINES is in the same record description entry: the glossary says 'Record Description Entry. The total set of data description entries associated with a particular record' (cite.py: 'OK §1985:III.2 the text is in the clause'). cite.py: 'OK §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR2' ('must be the name of a data item specified as a record key associated with file-name-1'); 'OK §1985:IX.2.7.4 GR3' ('are implicitly referenced as keys for all other record description entries of that file'). RecordLayout.KeyIndexOfKeyItem says it admits 'a REDEFINES of the key, or a same-position item in a secondary 01' as GR4's other-record implicit key. That is how the REDEFINES gets through. Side observations: r3-altother (an other-record item at the alternate key's positions) compiles, which is correct under GR3. r3-numother (PIC 9(4) at the prime key's positions in IX-REC2) is refused (COBOL0864) under PB5794's 'shares class/category' reading. Under GR3 those positions are implicitly keys, so this refusal is a second reading point. kb/Work: PB354 (landed) covers START, and no note covers the same-record REDEFINES.
refuter.corrected: NON-CONFORMING (under-rejects), cause (b), the same at --std 2023. RecordLayout.KeyIndexOfKeyItem's positional arm accepts any identical-width item in a record of the file, including a REDEFINES inside the key's own record description entry, where §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR2 with IX.2.7.4 GR3 admits only the declared key or an item in ANOTHER record description entry. Repro: r3-redef.cob; expected a refusal (SR2); observed exit 0. No kb/Work note.
